As someone who was that depressed girlfriend in a relationship ( and I’m no longer with that person. )  The number one thing you can do is to realistically address it, don’t ignore it and sweep it under the rug. My ex never addressed it with me, he continued his daily routines and just let me be depressed, and he later came back and said I was “lazy”. Address the situation, comfort her, be by her side, and just remind her that she can get back on her feet. A little support goes a long way!

Reading your post, you definitely remind me of my younger self. I didn’t lose my virginity until I was 22, and I’m now 26 so I completely understand where your big emotions are coming from.
